name: check.leak-scan

# DENY-LIST LAYER. Terms with no generic shape (people, products, projects)
# are read at run time through the role in the LEAK_SCAN_ROLE_ARN secret.

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, edited]

jobs:
  leak-scan:
    uses: example/shared/.github/workflows/_reusable.leak-scan.yml@0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    with:
      allowed-repo-refs: shared, docs
      enforce: false
      use-shared-deny-list: true
    secrets:
      aws-role-arn: ${{ secrets.LEAK_SCAN_ROLE_ARN }}
